lede: Eatonton lights the Great Tree on the Putnam County Courthouse lawn, adds free carriage rides, a Santa morning at The Plaza Arts Center and a downtown parade.
celebrates: Visit Eatonton, the tourism bureau for Eatonton and Putnam County, lists the season's events around the Putnam County Courthouse and The Plaza Arts Center. A Christmas Evening in Eatonton on December 3 brings the Great Tree lighting, free horse-drawn carriage rides and a shopping punch card. Santa visits The Plaza Arts Center on December 5 for crafts and face painting. The Christmas parade rolls through downtown on December 12 with food trucks and craft vendors on the courthouse lawn, and Lakepoint Community Church offers a free Live Nativity on December 18 and 19.

facts: Eatonton's downtown centers on the Putnam County Courthouse lawn, where the Great Tree is lit each December and Santa takes photos after the parade. The Plaza Arts Center is at 305 North Madison Avenue, and Georgia Writers Museum in Eatonton hosts author talks listed on the same tourism calendar. The parade is presented by Eatonton Main Street and travels along Jefferson Avenue, according to a Messenger news story.

faq: Eatonton lights the Great Tree on the courthouse lawn on December 3, offers free carriage rides that night, hosts a Santa morning at The Plaza Arts Center on December 5 and holds its downtown Christmas parade on December 12.
When is the Eatonton Christmas parade in 2026?
The parade starts at 6 pm on Saturday, December 12, 2026 in downtown Eatonton, and Santa is available for photos on the courthouse lawn afterward from 6:30 to 9 pm.
Where can kids meet Santa in Eatonton?
Kids can meet Santa at Santa at The Plaza on December 5 from 10 am to noon and for photos after the parade on December 12 on the Putnam County Courthouse lawn.
Are there free Christmas events in Eatonton?
Yes. The Christmas parade and the Live Nativity at Lakepoint Community Church are listed as free, and A Christmas Evening in Eatonton offers free horse-drawn carriage rides.
